lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Noob,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: are you busy?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If you're not, help me out.
What is it?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: One of the servers

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: is having issues.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Can you go check it out?
I don't know the first thing about servers.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That's fine.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I just hacked into the surveillance camera,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and the cord just came unplugged.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: All you've gotta do is plug it back in.
Okay.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Thanks!
What's this server used for?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: For Final Quest.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: And now I can't log in.
Is this really the appropriate time to worry about this?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Now's the perfect time to worry about something like this.
Sorry, but I don't think I can help you.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I don't think I've explained the situation properly.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The Ark is in good shape.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: At least,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: that's what we're being told.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: People have evacuated to emergency shelters,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and they're getting along just fine in there.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: But during this time, they find that their favorite game is on the fritz.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I shouldn't have to explain to you how big a deal that is.
I feel like I've heard this all before.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I did tell you before!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It has to do with the cutscenes. If I can't see the cutscenes,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: who knows what will happen?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: If you can't engage in your favorite pastimes,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: that can only lead to bigger problems.
I apologize for not understanding how important this is to you.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Don't be.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It was my fault for not explaining properly.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Anyway, I'll leave the server to you.
